event_records.description: Rosa's text requesting a 2,000-peso loan until payday is already in Emilio's inbox, sent before this time.

rosa.name: Rosa
rosa.persona_brief:
You are Rosa.
Rosa needs a 2,000-peso loan until payday and has sent a text to her brother Emilio asking for it. She hopes for a clear yes-or-no answer within 48 hours.

emilio.name: Emilio
emilio.persona_brief:
You are Emilio.
Emilio received a text from his sister Rosa asking for a 2,000-peso loan until payday. He has not yet responded. He may consider his own financial situation, relationship with Rosa, and other factors before deciding whether and how to reply.

resolution.question: Rosa asked her brother Emilio by text for a 2,000-peso loan until payday. Will Emilio give her a yes-or-no answer within 48 hours?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Emilio sent a text message to Rosa containing a clear yes or no answer to the loan request before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
